title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 088
review_goal: Differentiate stopwatch, store, and suitcase variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round stopwatch face with one vertical hand and one small side knob at the upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a clean stopwatch face with a straight hand and minimal top hardware.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stopwatch with the angled hand and extra top loop around the crown.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the hand vertical and the upper hardware simpler than the other stopwatch variant.

items.depicts_observation: Round stopwatch face with one angled hand and one top loop and one small side button
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the stopwatch to show a more active angled hand and a pronounced top loop crown.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plainer stopwatch when the face should not rely on the large top loop or angled hand.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the top loop crown and angled hand that make it more detailed than the first stopwatch variant.

items.depicts_observation: Storefront awning above one open boxy counter with no door in the base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a shop front that reads more like an open counter under an awning.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the full store building when the base should show a centered door under the awning.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot leaves the lower base open like a counter instead of drawing a door in the middle.

items.depicts_observation: Storefront awning above one square building face with one centered door in the base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fuller retail building with a clear door beneath the awning.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the open counter storefront when the base should not stay empty under the awning.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot anchors the store with a centered door and fuller building body under the awning.

items.depicts_observation: Tall suitcase with one top handle and two vertical side rails framing the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants luggage to read as a taller travel case with upright side rails.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the briefcase style suitcase when the front should be crossed by two horizontal bands instead of side rails.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot draws the suitcase taller with vertical side rails rather than wide horizontal front bands.
